name: Covarion.MultiFreq

args.name: submodel
args.description: Constructs a branch model from its frequency vector

args.name: freqs
args.description: The weighted distribution of frequency vectors available to nodes

args.name: nodeFreqs
args.description: The frequency vector assigned to each node

args.name: pi1
args.description: Fraction of time spent in the ON state

description:
Allows composition to vary among branches of a rooted tree. Each node selects a frequency vector from a weighted collection of n vectors. A branch uses the vector assigned to its child node to construct its substitution model; the root assignment determines the starting frequencies. These branch-specific equilibrium frequencies need not equal the actual frequencies reached along the tree.

Also allows ON/OFF switching and rate variation among sites. Each site retains its rate category throughout the tree; its rate is zero while OFF. The ON/OFF switching rates are shared across branches and rate categories.
